feature: QUIC batch STREAM validation reuses range metadata for exact wire length

implementation: STREAM send-range validation returns the already checked end offset plus stream-ID and optional offset varint lengths.
The stateful batch preflight derives the exact STREAM wire length from that result instead of calling Frame.wireLen and recomputing the same end/varint metadata.
Non-STREAM frames, ordinary single-packet preparation, frame encoding, flow-control transactions, and final-size validation retain their existing paths.

candidate.observation: Every retained Frame.wireLen stack was under ordinary single-packet prepareFramesForSend; the stateful batch caller disappeared.

h3_shaped_stream4_50k.interpretation: PMU work improves while sequential wall time is 0.17% slower with one win and one scheduler outlier; the unchanged sequential logic is checked separately below.

datagram_control_50k.interpretation: The compile-time pure-DATAGRAM path bypasses the changed STREAM validation; instructions and both wall-time paths are neutral, while cycles do not regress.

real_h3_fixed_binary.interpretation: Every arm completed exact bytes, checksum, four FINs, and HTTP status against the same quic-go v0.59.0 peer. The 0.22% paired result is retained only as no-regression evidence.

compact_validated_traits.reason: Packing the 32-byte validated Traits into a 16-byte flagged summary added more instructions and alias/branch cost than the removed ABI copy. The original Traits value boundary is retained.

minimum_one_millisecond_pacing_deadline.reason: The timer floor did not converge userspace wire shape and reduced ordinary netz upload throughput by roughly 90%. The congestion-derived rate, ten-packet burst, and sub-millisecond deadline remain unchanged.

short_datagram_control.observation: The 20k cycles control favored the baseline by 0.68% with one candidate win. The 2.5-times-longer 50k decision row above reversed that to a 0.42% candidate improvement with three wins; the short row is retained as noise evidence.

verification.quic_go_http3: QUIC v1/v2 bidirectional cancellation, STOP_SENDING recovery, trailers, redirect/pool reuse, and informational response matrices passed
verification.quic_go_loss_reorder: 32/64-stream mixed FIN/reset churn passed for both endpoint-role pairs, both sender roles, loss and reordering, two runs per arm
verification.tquic: HTTP/3 normal, Retry, connection reuse, and two-phase GOAWAY passed in both endpoint-role directions

scope: The microbenchmark and real-H3 rows are same-application-shape, not equal-wire claims.
remaining_gap: AES-CTR/GHASH dominate protection cost. The complete Traits value boundary remains because both borrowed-pointer and compact-summary variants regress fixed PMU. Kernel packet capture still requires CAP_NET_RAW on this host.
